description:
Create a new Risk Exception in Eramba GRC. 

Goal: Formally document the temporary acceptance of the 'Phishing Attacks on Employees' risk due to a delay in the email gateway upgrade.

Instructions:
1. Navigate to the Risk Management module and find the Risk Exceptions section.
2. Create a new Risk Exception with the following details:
   - Title: 'Email Gateway Upgrade Delay - Phishing Risk Acceptance'
   - Description: 'The planned Barracuda Email Security Gateway deployment has been delayed from Q1 to Q3 2025 due to vendor supply chain constraints. During this interim period, the organization formally accepts the elevated phishing risk. Compensating controls include: (1) mandatory bi-weekly phishing simulation exercises for all staff, (2) enhanced SOC monitoring of email-borne threats with 15-minute SLA on suspicious email reports, and (3) temporary deployment of additional browser isolation for finance and HR departments. This exception was approved by CISO David Chen on 2025-01-15.'
   - Expiration / Review Date: '2025-12-31'
   - Status: Open (or Active)
3. Associate this exception with the existing risk: 'Phishing Attacks on Employees'.
4. Save the record.

metadata.expected_title: Email Gateway Upgrade Delay - Phishing Risk Acceptance
